properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Changeable here: upgrade or drop the provider dependencies that pull hash.js. hash.js@1.1.7 declared in pnpm-lock.yaml — SHA-1/224/256/384/512 (and MD5) implementations transitively shipped in the web3/wallet-provider dependency graph (elliptic uses hash.js for internal hashing); no first-party import in the UI-library source (grep of all .ts/.tsx/.js found none). Availability inventory: the algorithm ships in the built dependency graph whether or not the components call it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile declaration (pnpm-lock.yaml:10815, optional: true, not dev-only) of crypto-js@4.1.1, which ships MD5 among its primitives. Pulled in by the web3 stack (moralis/react-moralis); no application source file imports it directly. Changeable only by bumping/removing the upstream dependency that requires it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Changeable here: crypto-js is legacy and unmaintained; replace with @noble/hashes where a consumer needs SHA-1 compatibility. crypto-js@4.1.1 declared in pnpm-lock.yaml ships SHA-1 among its hash implementations; transitively part of the web3-provider dependency graph, no first-party call site found in packages/ or apps/. Availability inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Changeable here: only by upgrading the provider chain (moralis/web3auth), since no first-party code imports it. secp256k1@3.8.1/4.0.4 (+@types/secp256k1@4.0.6) pinned in pnpm-lock.yaml — the indutny ECDSA secp256k1 package, transitively behind the moralis/@web3auth runtime deps declared at packages/web3/package.json:40-43. Quantum-unsafe signature curve (Shor); migration is ML-DSA class. No first-party call site in the UI-library source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: evp_bytestokey@1.0.3 implements OpenSSL's EVP_BytesToKey (single-iteration MD5 KDF) as part of the crypto-browserify stack that @walletconnect/web3-provider pulls into the browser bundle. Weak KDF available in shipped tree; no application call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Changeable here: only via the provider chain. bcrypt-pbkdf@1.0.2 (OpenBSD bcrypt-based PBKDF for deriving keys from passphrases, not bcrypt password hashing) declared in pnpm-lock.yaml, transitively shipped in the web3-provider graph (sshpk/web3-provider-engine chain). No first-party call site. Availability inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/curves@1.4.2 declared at pnpm-lock.yaml:3426 (alongside 1.9.2 at 3432); ships secp256k1 ECDSA used for Ethereum key/signature handling by the wallet stack. Quantum-unsafe signature primitive available in shipped tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Changeable here: only via the provider chain. create-ecdh@4.0.4 (browserify ECDH) pinned in pnpm-lock.yaml, transitively shipped via the crypto-browserify chain behind the web3/moralis runtime deps. ECDH key agreement is Shor-retroactively breakable; no first-party ECDH use found in the component-library source. Availability inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Changeable here: drop or upgrade @web3auth/web3auth (declared at packages/web3/package.json:43). @toruslabs/openlogin-ed25519@2.0.0 pinned in pnpm-lock.yaml — Ed25519 signing for the Torus/Web3Auth v1 login flow, transitively behind @web3auth/web3auth@^1.1.0, a runtime dependency of the published @web3uikit/web3 package. No first-party call site. Ed25519 is Shor-vulnerable; migration ML-DSA class.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 available in @noble/curves@1.4.2 (pnpm-lock.yaml:3426), part of the web3 dependency tree. Quantum-unsafe signature primitive present in the shipped library; used by wallet/session code upstream, not by application code directly.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 (pnpm-lock.yaml:11527, with 6.6.1 at 11538) implements ECDSA over secp256k1/secp256r1; dependency of ethers v5 inside the WalletConnect/Moralis web3 stack. Classical EC signatures in the shipped tree; no direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Changeable here: only via the provider chain. @noble/curves@1.4.2 pinned in pnpm-lock.yaml — P-256 (secp256r1) among its curve set, transitively behind the Torus/Web3Auth chain. Shor-vulnerable if used for ECDH/ECDSA. No first-party call site. Availability inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 (pnpm-lock.yaml:21681, dev: false; also 1.0.3 at 21685) provides crypto_scalarmult (X25519) alongside crypto_box. X25519 key agreement present in the shipped tree via the WalletConnect stack.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: keccak@3.0.4 (js-sha3-based Keccak) and @ethersproject/keccak256@5.6.0 declarations across 13 lockfile sites — Ethereum's Keccak-256 (pre-standard SHA-3 padding) used by the ethers v5/Web3 stack for transaction and ABI hashing. Production dependency of the wallet stack; no first-party call site (the library code calls it, not this repo's components).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 available in the shipped tree via three packages: pbkdf2@3.1.3 (crypto-browserify stack, pnpm-lock.yaml:18327), @ethersproject/pbkdf2@5.6.0 (ethers v5, used for BIP39/key derivation, entry at 2548) and @types/pbkdf2. Production deps pulled by the WalletConnect/ethers web3 stack; iteration counts are caller-chosen (ethers keystore files use 262144 SHA-256 rounds by default upstream).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Changeable here: only via the provider chain. scrypt-js@3.0.1 pinned in pnpm-lock.yaml — scrypt KDF, transitively shipped via @ethersproject/json-wallets@5.6.0 (BIP-3 keystore decryption) behind the moralis/web3 runtime deps. No first-party call site. Availability inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Changeable here: only via the provider chain. crypto-js@4.1.1 pinned in pnpm-lock.yaml ships AES; transitively part of the web3-provider graph, no first-party call site found. Availability inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Changeable here: only via the provider chain. @noble/hashes@1.4.0 pinned in pnpm-lock.yaml — SHA-256 among its digests, transitively behind @walletconnect/crypto and the Torus chain. No first-party call site. Availability inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.value: XSalsa20-Poly1305 (crypto_box/secretbox) available via tweetnacl@0.14.5 and tweetnacl@1.0.3 (pnpm-lock.yaml:21681/21685, dev: false) — production deps of the WalletConnect stack. Symmetric AE, not Shor-relevant; present in shipped tree.

properties.value: @noble/hashes resolved at 1.4.0/1.7.0/1.8.0 (pnpm-lock.yaml:3439/3444/3449) — the hash layer for @noble/curves and the WalletConnect web3 stack. Ships SHA-2, SHA-3, BLAKE2/BLAKE3, RIPEMD-160, HKDF, PBKDF2 and scrypt. Multiple versions resolved side by side. No first-party import in application code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js@4.1.1 (pnpm-lock.yaml:10815, optional: true, not dev-only) is the legacy crypto library — ships MD5, SHA-1, SHA-2, HMAC, PBKDF2, AES, DES, RC4 and more. Referenced by react-native-crypto consumers at 17172/17191 in the moralis/wallet stack. Algorithm-level facets are recorded separately (e.g. ALG-70109388 MD5). Changeable only by removing/bumping the upstream dependency.

properties.value: scrypt-js@3.0.1 (pnpm-lock.yaml:20065) — pure-JS scrypt used by @ethersproject/json-wallets for keystore-file key derivation in the ethers v5 web3 stack. Production dep; no first-party call site in this repo's components.
